events.title: U.S. Constitution Signed
events.description: Delegates to the Constitutional Convention in Philadelphia signed the final draft of the United States Constitution, after which it was sent to the states for ratification.
events.significance: The Constitution became the foundation of American government and one of the most influential founding documents in the world. The date is commemorated annually as Constitution Day and Citizenship Day.

events.title: Battle of Antietam
events.description: Union forces under General George B. McClellan clashed with Confederate forces led by General Robert E. Lee near Sharpsburg, Maryland, in the bloodiest single day in American military history, with about 22,000 casualties.
events.significance: The Union's strategic victory halted Lee's first invasion of the North and gave President Lincoln the opportunity to issue the preliminary Emancipation Proclamation, shifting the war's aims toward ending slavery.

events.title: Soviet Union Invades Poland
events.description: Sixteen days after Germany's invasion of Poland, the Red Army crossed the Polish eastern border in accordance with the secret protocol of the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact.
events.significance: The invasion led to the partition of Poland between Germany and the USSR and the Soviet occupation of eastern Poland, shaping the early course of World War II and the region's postwar borders.

events.title: Camp David Accords Signed
events.description: Egyptian President Anwar Sadat and Israeli Prime Minister Menachem Begin signed the Camp David Accords at the White House after twelve days of secret negotiations hosted by U.S. President Jimmy Carter.
events.significance: The accords led to the 1979 Egypt-Israel peace treaty, the first peace agreement between Israel and an Arab state, and earned Sadat and Begin the Nobel Peace Prize.

events.title: Space Shuttle Enterprise Unveiled
events.description: NASA rolled out the first Space Shuttle orbiter, Enterprise, at Rockwell International's facility in Palmdale, California, in a ceremony attended by cast members of Star Trek.
events.significance: Enterprise was used for atmospheric approach and landing tests that validated the shuttle's design, paving the way for the Space Shuttle program that operated from 1981 to 2011.
